newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo Elec aims for Y1.5 trln prnt sales 2000/01.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo Elec aims for Y1.5 trln prnt sales 2000/01.

text.p: Japanese consumer electronics company Sanyo Electric Co Ltd said on Monday that it would aim for annual parent sales of 1.5 trillion yen and group sales of 2.5 trillion yen in the year to March 31, 2001.
The company plans group capital investment of 600 billion yen in the four years to the end of March 2001, Sanyo president Yasuaki Takano was quoted as saying by a company spokesman.
A large portion of the funds will be invested in its semiconductor- and battery-related businesses, Takano said.
Sanyo expects to post parent sales of 1.09 trillion yen and group sales of 1.77 trillion yen in the 1996/97 business year which ended on March 31.
